top5.title: Flow cytometry-based drug response profiling of primary B-precursor ALL cells in co-culture with bone marrow-derived stromal cells
top5.why: Flow cytometry-based drug profiling in stromal co-cultures reduces spontaneous cell death artifacts in primary ALL cells, enabling reliable ex vivo screening of therapeutic agents over extended periods.

top5.title: Membranous Ezrin Expression Is Associated With Regional Lymph Node Involvement in Canine Mast Cell Tumours
top5.authors: Dos Santos MA … da Silva Leite J
top5.why: Membranous ezrin expression levels correlate with regional lymph node involvement in canine mast cell tumors, suggesting a potential marker for disease progression assessment.

top5.title: Long-read nanopore sequencing: A rapid and highly accurate approach for IGHV gene analysis in chronic lymphocytic leukaemia
top5.authors: Del Peso Santos T … Rosenquist R
top5.why: Long-read nanopore sequencing accurately determines IGHV gene somatic hypermutation status in CLL within 24 hours at reduced cost compared to current methods.

top5.title: T-cell engager bispecific antibodies enable T cells to eliminate Multiple Myeloma by targeting tumor CD38 in combination with PD-L1
top5.why: Bispecific antibodies targeting CD38 and PD-L1 simultaneously enhance T-cell killing of multiple myeloma cells in vitro, even when CD38 expression is reduced.

top5.title: Oncolytic Viruses Armed with Multiple Immunomodulatory Transgenes in Cancer Immunotherapy
top5.why: Multi-transgene-armed oncolytic viruses can enhance immune activation and overcome tumor microenvironment immunosuppression better than single-transgene approaches in preclinical models.

also.title: Mechanisms and Implications of SARS-CoV-2 Infection in Hematopoietic System
also.why: SARS-CoV-2 damages hematopoiesis primarily through indirect mechanisms involving spike protein exposure and inflammatory mediators rather than direct viral infection of most blood precursors.

also.title: RNA folding drives species-dependent host mRNA partitioning in Ebola virus condensates
also.why: Ebola virus condensates selectively sequester host mRNAs based on RNA secondary structure, stabilizing interferon-stimulated genes and contributing to severe disease in humans while bats evade this mechanism through structural differences in their ISG 3' UTRs.

also.title: RT1640 and Melanocyte Stem-Cell Regeneration: A Translational Perspective on Hair Graying
also.why: Primary research in a leading general journal. Topics: melanocyte.

also.title: ID3 endowment and TGFBR2 deletion enhance iPSC-derived CAR macrophage immunotherapy for hepatocellular carcinoma
also.why: ID3 endowment and TGFBR2 deletion enhance iPSC-derived CAR macrophage infiltration and antitumor activity in hepatocellular carcinoma through strengthened inflammatory and phagocytic programs.

also.title: Measuring tumor cell killing using in vivo bioluminescence imaging
also.why: Bioluminescence imaging enables longitudinal quantification of CAR T cell-mediated killing of multiple myeloma in bone marrow microenvironments within living mice.

also.title: Construction and immunogenicity evaluation of recombinant Bacillus subtilis expressing VP8 protein of porcine rotavirus
also.why: Oral recombinant B. subtilis expressing PoRV VP8 proteins with CTB fusion induces mucosal and systemic antibody responses and Th1/Th2 cytokine activation in mice.
